units.source_text: 据老太婆说，老大爷患了中风症，半身不遂。

en.t: According to the old woman, the old man had suffered a stroke and was paralyzed on one side.

units.source_text: 他身边的纸山，是各县寄来的治疗中风症的药方，以及从各县邮购来的盛满治疗中风症药品的纸袋。

en.t: The mountain of paper beside him consisted of stroke remedies sent from various prefectures, along with paper bags full of stroke medicines he had ordered by mail from those places.

units.source_text: 听说，凡是治疗中风症的药方，不管是从翻山越岭前来的旅客的口中听到的，

en.t: It was said that whenever he heard of any remedy for stroke, whether from travelers who had come over mountains and passes,

units.source_text: 还是从广告中读到的，他都一一照方抓药。

en.t: or read about it in an advertisement, he would obtain the medicine exactly as prescribed, one remedy after another.

units.source_text: 这些信和纸袋，他一张一个也不扔掉，都堆放在自己的身边，凝视着它们打发日子。

en.t: He did not throw away a single one of those letters or paper bags, but piled them all beside him and spent his days gazing at them.

units.source_text: 天长日久，这些破旧的废纸就堆积如山了。

en.t: Over the long months and years, those worn-out scraps of paper piled up like a mountain.
